containers.name: state_history
containers.role: Mechanical state and path-dependent constitutive history; no assumed equation law from storage class.

containers.name: preparation
containers.role: Raw inputs, override mask, resolved parameter values, initial stress correction, normalization provenance and preparation epoch; immutable during ordinary caller advances.

containers.name: lag_cache
containers.role: Algorithm-required next-caller-step values; recompute only under declared stage/boundary policy, not as arbitrary performance cache.

containers.name: user_mode
containers.role: Explicit selected PostShake mode and other admitted finite modes; request commands distinct from current mode.

containers.name: host_subzone_state
containers.role: Independent host stabilization state per subzone; unknown layout blocks full-host admission.

containers.name: host_workspace
containers.role: Trial-only reduction scratch; incomplete-step restart unsupported.

containers.name: derived
containers.role: Pure stage evaluations with explicit dependency snapshots.

containers.name: diagnostics
containers.role: Attempt counters and provisional event trace; cannot influence material evolution.

snapshot_contract.parent: Immutable complete incoming snapshot, including every retained history, lag value, mode and applicable clock/strain/host state.
snapshot_contract.caller_input: Full declared increment, optional actual time interval, frame, host weights, user command and algorithm settings; independent of output sampling.
snapshot_contract.prepared: One provisional preparation/reset snapshot per candidate transaction; identity map when no command/reset applies.
snapshot_contract.phase_outputs: Named immutable records; no read of a later phase and no mutable implicit new namespace.
snapshot_contract.within_phase: All guards and RHS expressions read the same input snapshots and assignments apply simultaneously; unique target per phase; reject cycles/undeclared cross-phase reads.
snapshot_contract.conditional_evaluation: Future phased contract evaluates guard first; evaluates only selected assignment RHS/dependencies. Guard finite and signed scalar if using sign rule. Legacy eager-derived behavior is preserved by its adapter.
snapshot_contract.conflicts: Multiple writes to the same target require explicit separate phase edges; competing event writes without declared composition are rejected.
snapshot_contract.publication: Only validated candidate_full_snapshot can be atomically published. Intermediate source term commit refers to local provisional stage, not a public durable commit.
snapshot_contract.base: The successful provisional prepared snapshot is the base for all within-caller-step history reads; otherwise base=parent. Incoming parent remains the rollback target even if preparation succeeded.

outer_transaction.action: Validate version/capabilities, parent, preparation lineage, units/shapes/scales, caller inputs and supported command; do not repair parent.
Allocate private trial snapshot/workspace, sharing immutable parameters; clear trial-only counters/sums.
Apply supported explicit reset/mode command provisionally using the same parent and caller input for every outer candidate.
Run declared model phase DAG; no caller-visible writes and no durable event logs.
Check complete required outputs, finite values, domain, host reduction completion, stage tags, budgets and caller controls.
Mixed-control solver may accept a candidate endpoint; selection still does not mutate caller parent.
Publish state/history, preparation epoch, lag caches, modes, time/strain and host state together exactly once; publish accepted event records only then.
Return incoming snapshot values and identity exactly, with failure location and attempted-work diagnostics; discard all candidate events/workspace.

caller_and_subdivision.caller_increment: Physical algorithm boundary at which admitted caller-stage resets/lag advancement occur; explicit path knots define it, not sampling, Newton iterations or numerical cutbacks.
caller_and_subdivision.PM4_documented_policy: Explicit full caller step with end-zone update and one-step D/Kp lag; constitutive substepping absent from manual implementation.
caller_and_subdivision.proposed_initial_PM4_scope: No internal subdivision support. If full trial fails, fail transaction; caller may submit explicit finer increments with new recorded provenance.
caller_and_subdivision.future_subdivisions: Require separate declared policy and reference evidence. Legacy parent-reset adapter freezes caller reset across internal subdivisions while continuous state and _n evolve per accepted internal substep; do not infer same policy for PM4 lag.
caller_and_subdivision.zero_increment: Material update dispatch is distinct from observation. Existing replay duplicate targets preserve history and skip integration; explicit reset/mode commands need a separate command boundary and must not disappear through observation deduplication.
caller_and_subdivision.physical_time: No PM4 physical time dependence inferred. Timed ODE adapter retains clock atomically; no previous-state/caller de injected into an ODE RHS.
caller_and_subdivision.rejected_outer_trials: Each finite-difference probe, line search, restart seed and mixed-control candidate forks the same committed parent plus same pending explicit command; no accumulation across candidates.

ordered_snapshot_example.status: illustrative dependency notation only; not an admitted PM4 assignment program
ordered_snapshot_example.desired_generic_property: previous receives old initial even when initial receives current alpha in another ordered phase; source must choose actual phase ordering.
ordered_snapshot_example.fabric_snapshot_requirement: Source must select whether z_in reads old fabric or updated fabric; contract refuses ambiguous new.z.

cache_policy.algorithm_cache: D/Kp retained even if algebraically derivable with earlier-stage inputs; they are not arbitrary memoization.
cache_policy.memoization_scope: At most one transaction; reuse across different candidate loading/parent/settings forbidden unless key exact.
cache_policy.restart: Serialize required algorithmic cache and stage/epoch metadata; reject missing cache unless source-validated reconstruction exists.
cache_policy.diagnostics: Attempt counts may differ without changing committed material data.

derivative_policy.continuous_unknowns: Separate coupled solve unknowns from retained copied histories/caches; do not put all persistent fields in one AD vector automatically.
derivative_policy.frozen_snapshots: No inner derivative through caller-selected discrete assignments unless an explicit differentiability contract is added.
derivative_policy.outer_probes: Include candidate-dependent preparation naturally by fresh transactions; guard crossings may be nonsmooth.
derivative_policy.tangent_claim: No consistent tangent through PM4 events or source-host update claimed.
derivative_policy.capacity: Existing32-component model/Jet limits unchanged. This proposal is not an allocation authorization.

initialization_and_modes.result: Admissible initialized snapshot or exact unchanged incoming host state on failure; record source corrections/default resolution.

initialization_and_modes.scope: explicit preparation reset from current host stress
initialization_and_modes.result: Erase specified histories and reinitialize caches; new epoch only on commit; exact default recomputation unresolved.
Apply user mode at declared next caller update; source ordering/domain gate required; no autonomous trigger from time.
Does not invoke FirstCall, renormalize CSR, recompute initial defaults, clear fabric or toggle PostShake.

unsupported: Execution of this proposal by existing schema0.1/0.2 loaders or legacy APIs.
PM4 constitutive kernel, complete initialization, inferred z_alpha evolution or repaired source equations.
Large-strain rotations/objectivity for all history tensors.
Automatic continuous event location, event prioritization, accepted-substep resets, time-triggered mode changes, DAEs or arbitrary multistep histories.
Automatic partition invariance for caller-stage lag/event algorithms.
Automatic material-point or runtime admission merely because a field inventory fits allocated memory.

source_blockers.INIT-SIGNS: One explicit Chapter2/host tension-positive sign map, pressure floors and Table3.3 trace notation.
source_blockers.INIT-BRANCHES: sigma11=0, xi_R=0, Mfin=Mcut, hydrostatic Lode direction and critical Ado limit.
source_blockers.RESET-DEFAULTS: Exact secondary override/default recomputation on later FirstCall=0.
source_blockers.STRESS-CORRECTION: Printed Table3.1 step7(b)(ii) versus clean Eqs35-37 and complete plastic update.
source_blockers.HOST-PARENT: Exact subzone stress parent versus main zone state and independent hourglass law/state.
source_blockers.HOST-AVERAGING: Weights, corrected p/r/n consistency and whether averaged n is normalized.
source_blockers.PENALTIES: Exact consistency/bounding projection algorithm, domain handling and tie policy.
source_blockers.EVENT-STAGE: Exact corrected/averaged alpha and n used for reversal decision.
source_blockers.LAG-DEPENDENCIES: Complete old/new stage dependency map for D and Kp before new fabric/g/surfaces.
source_blockers.FABRIC-PRODUCT: Well-typed z*p metric, signs, zxpPk/pzp,peak aliases and strict/equal peak update policy.
source_blockers.FABRIC-ZERO-D: Source-matched finite fabric update at D=0; reconcile cumulative Eq65 and algorithm prose.
source_blockers.FABRIC-SNAPSHOT: z_in before/after same-step fabric update; unexplained z_alpha.
source_blockers.DENSITY: Exact density/volume update, state representation, restart and reset behavior.
source_blockers.CSR-NORMALIZER: Exact initialization scalar provenance and dense/loose transitions.
source_blockers.ANCHOR-ORDER: Step19/20 duplication and exact old/new reversal snapshot assignments.
source_blockers.ANCHOR-EXTREMA: alpha_inMin/Max relation to apparent anchor and component loading direction.
source_blockers.ACCUMULATORS: Names/shapes, reset/clear cadence and role of strain increment accumulators.
source_blockers.ZERO-SPIN-SCOPE: Only zero-spin point reduction proposed; full rotation of all histories unsupported.
source_blockers.POSTSHAKE-DOMAINS: p_sed=0 and fractional-power domains, flag transitions and initial-density provenance.

acceptance_gates.name: parser_isolation
acceptance_gates.require: Proposal JSON rejected by model loader; current models and canonical hashes unchanged; no execution dispatch by candidate status.

acceptance_gates.name: typed_phase_validation
acceptance_gates.require: Scopes/units/shapes immutable snapshot reads validated; reject DAG cycles, duplicate writes, future reads, unknown layouts, invalid enum and missing required cache.

acceptance_gates.name: transaction_oracles
acceptance_gates.require: Synthetic analytical assignments test old/new snapshots, simultaneous phase swaps, lazy inactive branches, nonfinite guards and later failure after provisional work; exact full-parent rollback.

acceptance_gates.name: legacy_compatibility
acceptance_gates.require: All existing parent-reset, five-model references, recorded mixed-control and physical-time/timed schedule cases retain declared behavior and settings.

acceptance_gates.name: restart_and_lineage
acceptance_gates.require: Complete serialized snapshot restart reproduces endpoint; missing/wrong hashes/epochs/cache stages rejected; mode/reset events commit once.

acceptance_gates.name: PM4_source_resolution
acceptance_gates.require: Resolve all source_blockers or explicitly exclude capability/variant affected; independent review of exact selected manual/implementation.

acceptance_gates.name: bounded_PM4_numerics
acceptance_gates.require: Source-matched zero-spin homogeneous reference, caller-partition refinement, microcycle reversal, initialization/reset, lag and optional hourglass-separated tests; retained error metrics and source locations.

acceptance_gates.name: runtime_and_publication
acceptance_gates.require: After source and Python gates, controlled serial native and Wasm evidence with same contract/fixtures, then honest catalogue capability labels; no status promotion from engine tests alone.

migration_sequence: Document only: retain proposal outside executable model directories; confirm scope and source blockers.
Add future versioned experimental transaction-envelope schema with strict capability negotiation and synthetic <=32-unknown fixtures; do not change model schema defaults.
Implement Python interpreter and validation reference before generated code; use explicit typed snapshots and separate preparation/cache records.
Adapt existing v0.1 parent_increment resets and v0.2 timed ODEs with identity wrappers preserving evaluator/_n/clock semantics; never reinterpret them as PM4 phases.
Design storage/backend resources from resolved layouts and coupled unknown counts; no blanket max_state increase.
Implement generated/native envelope only after analytical reference tests pass; obtain separate serial-build authorization as appropriate.
Admit source-resolved PM4 homogeneous kernel separately; full-host and rotations remain distinct later capabilities.
